cards.title: Hands-On Fathers and Child Development
cards.body: Pioneering scientist Sarah Blaffer Hrdy explores how involved fatherhood could shape children's emotional development and future relationships. Her research challenges traditional views on parenting roles and their impact on family dynamics.

cards.title: Adult Child Moving Back Home
cards.body: Parents face new challenges when adult children return to the nest after graduation. Navigating this transition requires patience and adjusted expectations from both generations.

cards.title: Teen Online Safety and Well-Being
cards.body: Parents can better support teens by understanding what they hide online and creating safe spaces for open conversation. Research shows that addressing digital privacy concerns strengthens parent-teen relationships.

cards.title: Motivating Children for School Success
cards.body: American students show declining interest in learning, with many high schoolers avoiding reading. Parents play a crucial role in fostering academic motivation and curiosity.

cards.title: Understanding Neurodivergence Labels
cards.body: Labels matter in the neurodivergent community but shouldn't define a child's entire identity. Parents should use labels as tools while recognizing their child's unique strengths.

cards.title: Managing Children's Big Emotions
cards.body: Using the riverbank metaphor helps parents contain and support children's emotional expression without suppressing or amplifying their feelings. This approach teaches healthy emotional regulation.

cards.title: Explaining Adoption to Children
cards.body: During National Adoption Month, helping children understand their adoption story is vital for emotional well-being. Open, age-appropriate conversations strengthen family bonds and identity.

cards.title: Breaking Unhelpful Childhood Patterns
cards.body: Children can get stuck in mental and behavioral ruts, requiring courage to change. Picture books exploring resilience help kids understand they can break cycles.

cards.title: Planning Family Dynamics for Holidays
cards.body: Anticipating uncomfortable conversations and setting realistic expectations helps make family gatherings manageable. Clear communication about needs strengthens connections during stressful times.

cards.title: Childhood Trauma and Emotional Impact
cards.body: How children process grief depends on the context of trauma they experience. Understanding this helps parents support healing and resilience in their children.
